description: Builds proxy connection lines for a service with the chosen protocol, format, location targeting and session type: one line, or up to 1,000 sticky sessions with session sticky. Does not change the service. The output contains the proxy username and password, which let anyone who has them use the service.

asn.description: ASN digits without the AS prefix, if the service supports ASN targeting

city.description: City in lowercase letters, digits and underscores, if the service supports city targeting

count.description: With session sticky, how many sticky sessions to return, 1 to 1000. Other session types return one line.

country.description: Two-letter country code, if the service supports country targeting

format.description: Line format: host:port:user:pass (default), user:pass@host:port, user:pass, host:port, url or curl

lifetime.description: Sticky session lifetime in seconds, only with session sticky: 60 to 86400, or from 1 when the service has session_lifetime_seconds, at most 1800 with session_lifetime_30m, and whole minutes on Residential IPv4 Unlimited

region.description: Region code, if the service supports region targeting

session.description: Session type. sticky (Sticky) reuses an IP while available, for the session lifetime. rotate (Rotating) requests a new IP per connection, and the same IP can appear again. none uses the service default.

name: generate_endpoints
title: Generate endpoints
